title: A Demailly-type approximation of singular Finsler metrics
summary: We establish a Demailly-type approximation theorem for singular Finsler metrics satisfying the multiple coarse \(L^p\) extension property on holomorphic vector bundles. As an application, we obtain a new proof of the fact that the multiple coarse \(L^p\) extension property characterizes Griffiths positivity, as shown by Deng--Wang--Zhang--Zhou.
